articles.title: Airbnb CEO says X account was hacked, attacker posted AI-slop on tokenization
articles.snippet: Brian Chesky regained control of his account and told any new crypto followers he would be a "disappointing follow".

articles.title: Kaspersky identifies malware framework targeting crypto investors
articles.snippet: Cybersecurity company Kaspersky said a newly identified malware framework is targeting cryptocurrency investors through social engineering tactics and trojanized GitHub apps.
